topic: Updating and optimizing the CH platform
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main technical topics. First, an update to the 'CH' system was planned for the next day, involving deploying a new configuration before upgrading to version 25.1.

A second major topic concerned optimizing data storage and retrieval costs/performance. Currently, the system uses hot and cold storage on S3 (costing $130/month for 11.3 TB). The proposal is to migrate both cold and partially hot data to S3. To improve speed and potentially reduce cost, it was suggested using a local SSD cache instead of relying solely on hot/cold tiers, especially if most requests hit the local cache while rare date-time recalculations pull data from S3.

Separately, an API key issue for creating a project within AllUnite's OpenAI platform was resolved by someone else.
decisions: The CH system will be updated to version 25.1 after deploying a new configuration first.
action_items: Test the feasibility of using local SSD cache for data retrieval instead of relying solely on hot/cold S3 storage.
Someone needs to provide details on current disk costs (hot and cold) for the CH platform.
